WoW: Forever

Frost Mage

Freeze the target, then hit it for four times the damage (the tooltip reads +300%). Icy Veins: "with FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec., melee enemies will often not even reach you before killing them."

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Frost build has been tested. Talent tiers unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40, so a tier-3 talent like Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. arrives at exactly level 20, the eleventh point. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended.

What Frost is for

A freeze you can rely on: FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. 3/3 gives every Chill effect you apply a 15% chance to freeze the target, and Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. — instant, no cooldown — hits a frozen target for +300%. ShatterShatterTalentCastInstant 3/3 then adds 50% crit against that frozen target for three points, where Classic needed five.

Icy Veins rates it 3.5/5, second of the three Mage specs behind Arcane's 4/5, under the heading "Smooth and Steady, but Not Fast"; Wowhead and ClassicWoW.gg publish no levelling score. Its verdict: "Frost Mages are going to have a comfortable time leveling… slowing and chilling everything they fight keeps them safe. With FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec., melee enemies will often not even reach you before killing them."

The drawback, in the same source's words, is "the constant need to stop for mana." You will drink often; that is the "not Fast" half of its own heading.

On damage the published line is "Frost Mage won't top the damage meters, but few specs are as safe or as consistent." Read that against the only levelling scores any of the three publishes, which are Icy Veins' and which put Frost above Fire — 3.5/5 against 2.5/5.

Stat priority

Icy Veins is the only one of the three tracked sources that ranks Frost's stats; its order:

  1. Hit — "capping your Hit Chance is a high priority". Nobody publishes the actual cap: "There will be a cap where you can stop investing in this, but we don't know what it is yet."
  2. Spell Power (Frost) — scales every spell and your wand damage
  3. Critical strike — "Frost Mage is a crit-based spec": Ice ShardsIce ShardsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Frost spells by 100%. doubles the crit-damage bonus at 5/5
  4. Spirit — "Frost Mages have limited tools for resource management, so Spirit will be a good stat to increase where you can"
  5. Intellect — a bigger mana pool for a whole pull, plus a small crit bonus
  6. Stamina — a dump stat that comes along for free on most gear (Agility and Strength trail further behind, and Strength is explicitly "not useful")

What Forever changed for Frost

  • Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets. and Fingers of FrostFingers of FrostTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec. are both brand new, and together they are the spec.
  • The slows were cut hard. Improved BlizzardImproved BlizzardTalentCastInstantAdds a Chill effect to your Blizzard spell. This effect lowers the target's movement speed by 40% for 1.5 sec. maxes at 40% (Classic: 65%; rank 1 is 15% where Classic gave 30%). Cone of ColdCone of ColdLevel 26 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost210 ManaCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration6 sec is 40% over 6 seconds, down from 50% over 8. PermafrostPermafrostTalentCastInstantIncreases the duration of your Chill effects by 33% and reduces the target's speed by an additional 10%. was rewritten to +33% Chill duration and +10% extra slow at 3/3.
  • Winter's ChillWinter's ChillTalentCastInstant now applies only to your own FrostboltFrostboltLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration5 sec and Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets., where Classic let any Frost spell apply it. As of October 1 its application no longer rolls separately to resist — Blizzard's reasoning: the triggering spell already had to hit to apply it, so a second resist roll was redundant.
  • FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec. moved columns; Frost ChannelingFrost ChannelingTalentCastInstantReduces the mana cost of your Frost spells by 15% and reduces the threat caused by your Frost spells by 30%. moved up a tier; Ice BlockIce BlockLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost15 ManaCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration10 secYou become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells. moved to tier 4; Ice BarrierIce BarrierLevel 40 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost305 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration60 secInstantly shields you, absorbing 431 damage. Lasts 60 sec. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage. now requires Cold SnapCold SnapTalentCastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownFinishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells. rather than Ice Block.
  • Frostfire Bolt is a new trained Fire spell checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resistance. But rank 1 is level 40, so it is not in the beta.
  • Downranking is no longer free, and this spec feels it first. A spell cast well below your level now gets less benefit from Spell Power and a reduced chance to trigger your own talents — Blizzard's own example is this spec's: a rank 1 FrostboltFrostboltLevel 4 · Spell · FrostCast1.5 sec castCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration5 sec at level 60 has a 0% chance to proc FrostbiteFrostbiteTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to Freeze the target for 5 sec.. Rank-1 Frostbolt spam for a cheap slow, long a standard Frost habit, is no longer free; cast near your trained rank if you want the freeze.

At level 60

Unknown. The open question is whether Ice LanceIce LanceLevel 20 · Spell · FrostCastInstantCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeDeals 28 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets., Fingers of FrostFingers of FrostTalentCastInstantGives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec. and a personalised Winter's ChillWinter's ChillTalentCastInstant make Frost a real raid specialisation, or leave it the kiting spec it was in Classic.
